title: How Does Visa Make Money If It Lends You Nothing?
chapters: How does a card payment work?
Does Visa earn more when we spend more?
Is UPI a threat to Visa?

beats.say: How does Visa make money, if it lends you nothing? Banks pay it fees for the payments it carries. Picture a toll bridge, like a toll plaza on a highway. Visa is the bridge, and the booth.

beats.say: Does that matter? Around two thousand and six, investor Franswa Roshon compared three card companies. American Express lent money to its card holders. Visa and Mastercard did not. Then came two thousand and eight. Who got hurt?
beats.cap: Does that matter? Around 2006, investor François Rochon compared 3 card companies. American Express lent money to its card holders. Visa and Mastercard did not. Then came 2008. Who got hurt?
cues: Does that matter?
Around 2006, investor François Rochon compared 3 card companies.
American Express lent money to its card holders.
Visa and Mastercard did not.
Then came 2008.
Who got hurt?

beats.say: American Express got hurt, Franswa Roshon wrote. It had to set aside more money for loans that might never come back. Mastercard was spared those costs. And Visa, he wrote later, held up well through the crisis. In our reading, the bridge was the safer seat. So what keeps rivals off it?

beats.say: Why can't anyone copy Visa? Because so many people and shops already have it. Visa's report counts nearly five billion Visa cards, as of June twenty twenty five. They can be used at over a hundred and seventy five million shops and other places. In our reading, a new bridge would start with none.

beats.say: Our verdict on the business: Visa's moat is wide. Billions of cards and millions of shops use its bridge, and it keeps about half of what it takes in. Franswa Roshon, in his letter for twenty twenty five, called its moat the widest in card payments. It would weaken if fee limits cut deep, or most shoppers moved to cheaper roads.

beats.say: Quick recap. Banks pay Visa fees on each payment it carries. A tap asks for a yes, and the shop is paid, less a fee. Visa lends nothing. So many cards and shops use it that a newcomer starts at zero. More spending, more toll. In India, U P I is a cheaper road. Watch fee limits and cheaper roads.
